name: Satonaka Chie
source:
One of the main heroines, Chie is a second-year at Yasogami High School, [url=/c46285]Yuu[/url] and [url=/c51770]Yosuke's[/url] classmate and [url=/c46798]Yukiko's[/url] best friend. An energetic tomboy with a love of kung-fu movies, she is very outgoing and has a upbeat personality. Chie's biggest insecurity is her femininity. She has an inferiority complex in comparing herself to Yukiko and is jealous of all the male attention Yukiko receives. However, after she accepts her true self and realizes that she can just be herself, she gains the ability to wield the Persona, [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Tomoe]Tomoe[/url], who's based on [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tomoe_Gozen]Tome Gozen[/url], a female samurai who served in the [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genpei_War]Genpei War[/url], which led to the establishment of the [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamakura_shogunate]Kamakura Shogunate[/url].

Due to her hotblooded nature, Chie can be somewhat short-tempered, especially with Yosuke, and is slow to back down from a challenge. She also has a poster of Bruce Lee in her room. As to add to her tomboyish personality, she also loves meat, especially the steak at Junes. However, she and Yukiko are both horrible cooks to the point where their food was branded with the name "Myster Food X" because of its terrible appearance and appearance-matching flavor. Chie's inability as a cook is taken to such levels that she does not even know that there are differents kinds of flour.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Satonaka]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
